'''Bruce Savins''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Naboo Regionals]] on 12 September 1999 with Eloms/non-unique aliens, according to Mike Kessling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d38">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-13-naboo-reigonal-england-9-12-99d38/ naboo-reigonal-england-9-12-99], DeckTech (Mike "Kessling" Kessling, 13 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-13-naboo-reigonal-england-9-12-99d38/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
